summary: Run complete; nothing further is being submitted. Three investigations, each explained and each witnessed by two independent clean-copy runs: (1) explicit leadership transfer accepts a caller-named non-voter and reports success while the named target never leads and the incumbent must re-elect; (2) one allowed StoreLogs error in the conflict-truncation window wedges the follower permanently, costs exactly one unit of commitment-quorum margin, and is repaired only by a restart or a leader snapshot install (the latter, under defaults, only after roughly the trailing window of further entries), while a stale certificate cannot be turned into an election win; (3) the growth sequence the library documents commits the change and returns a successful future while removing the sole node's leadership and write availability, with no in-process API repair and the staged AddNonvoter form remaining safe. Twenty-four knowledge entries, counterevidence, limitations and the reproduction results are recorded; no necessary gaps remain.
